inputs.label: Folder containing your Mortal Kombat ROM files (mk.zip, mk2.zip, mk3.zip). MAME-style ZIPs.

exit_codes.1: The game could not start. Make sure bin/mk3 and its companion files (factory-seed.bin, gfx.txt) are in the bin/ folder.
exit_codes.2: No ROM files found in the selected folder. It must contain mk.zip, mk2.zip, and mk3.zip.
